name: Muse Glimmer 30B completes 10 of 10 everyday agent tasks in Hermes Agent on one RTX 5090
title: Muse Glimmer 30B completes 10 of 10 everyday agent tasks in Hermes Agent on one RTX 5090
summary: Running Meta's Muse Glimmer 30B as a Q4_K_M GGUF on llama.cpp at 64K context, a builder reports it finished all 10 short real tasks in Hermes Agent with no malformed tool calls, including fixing code and rerunning tests and recovering from a blocked sandbox by using the shell.
